evidence.excerpt: The current restaurant-linked CKDC food PDF names 17 products across flatbreads, snacks and smalls, sandwiches and bigs, including ingredient-style descriptions and a general raw-food warning, but no allergen matrix or cross-contact guide.

The homepage-linked Mallard & ChurchKey Toast storefront identifies 1337 14th St NW and exposes 13 CK Food products plus 12 non-alcoholic retail products among an otherwise alcohol-only retail catalog. It provides menu descriptions but no allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure.

The current restaurant-linked bottled beers and whiskeys PDF has a dedicated Non-Alcoholic page with 13 products. Its alcoholic beer and whiskey inventory is out of POC scope. The PDF provides no allergen matrix or cross-contact guide.

The current Summer ChurchKey drafts and drinks PDF has a dedicated Alcohol Free section with 12 products. The remainder of the surface is alcoholic and out of POC scope. No allergen matrix or cross-contact statement appears.

The official ChurchKey homepage identifies the 14th Street craft-beer bar, gives 1337 14th Street NW, Washington, DC 20005 and phone (202) 567-2576, and links the current food, drafts and drinks, bottled beer and whiskey, and Toast menus.
